name: Google BigQuery
desc: Query, analyze, and stream data into Google BigQuery — the fully managed, serverless data warehouse

actions.name: run_query
actions.description: Execute a SQL query on BigQuery and return the results as flat rows

actions.name: create_row
actions.description: Creates a single new row in a BigQuery table. Column fields are loaded from the table schema.

actions.name: create_rows
actions.description: Creates new rows of data in a BigQuery table (accepts an array of row objects). Rows are available to query within seconds.

actions.name: delete_rows
actions.description: Deletes one or more rows from a BigQuery table using a SQL WHERE condition.

actions.name: update_rows
actions.description: Updates one or more existing rows in a BigQuery table using SQL SET and WHERE expressions.

actions.name: find_one_row
actions.description: Find a single row by specifying a WHERE clause and an optional ORDER BY. Returns the first matching row, or empty if none found.

actions.name: find_or_create_row
actions.description: Searches for a row matching a WHERE clause. If found, returns it. If not found, inserts the provided row data and returns that.

actions.name: get_rows_for_job
actions.description: Retrieves the result rows from a completed BigQuery query job by Job ID. Use this after a "Query Job Completed" trigger to fetch the full result set.

actions.name: import_data
actions.description: Imports a batch of rows into a BigQuery table. Accepts a JSON array or newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON). Large datasets are automatically split into chunks.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_row
triggers.description: Triggers when a new row is added to a BigQuery table. Polls every 5 minutes by comparing the latest value in a sort column against the previous check.

triggers.name: updated_row
triggers.description: Triggers when an existing row is updated in a BigQuery table. Requires an `updated_at` TIMESTAMP column that is set whenever a row changes.

triggers.name: query_job_completed
triggers.description: Triggers when a BigQuery query job finishes successfully. Each flow run receives the job metadata and the result rows from that query.

triggers.name: new_job_completed
triggers.description: Triggers when any BigQuery job (query, load, copy, or extract) finishes. Returns the job metadata including status, type, and timing.
